text: Hi Marisol, I need to order Android test devices for the payments app before the 18th. The compatibility matrix needs eight phones across three screen sizes, and the supplier, Industrias Tecnomar, quoted 648 euros a unit for the rugged model, which is confidential until the framework contract is signed. Finance has approved up to twelve handsets under this quarter's test budget, and procurement can raise the purchase order as soon as I send you the list. Please do not include the foldable model, because it failed our camera test last year. The earliest delivery they promised is nine working days after the order.
